fields.Name: IT77 - Materialized Read Served From Snapshot
fields.Description: Live-DB proof that RunQuery(DataSource:'Materialized') is served from the physical snapshot, not the live source. Fabricates a snapshot table carrying a sentinel row absent from the live source, then MR1 asserts a Materialized read returns the sentinel AND its RenderedSQL references materialized_<...> + the surrogate order key; MR2 (negative control) asserts the SAME query read Live returns the sentinel nowhere. Server transport (RenderedSQL stripped by the GraphQL client). Self-cleaning fixtures; SQL-Server only (skips when no mssql pool).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A Materialized read is served from the snapshot (sentinel present + materialized_ RenderedSQL) while the same query read Live returns the sentinel nowhere. 2 checks (MR1-MR2).
